# The Golden Tooth Multispecialty Dental Clinic

> Multispecialty dental clinic in Thane West, Maharashtra, India, with two branches: Lodha (Majiwada) and Dhokali. Open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

## Contact
- Lodha Branch: 106 Boulevard Mall, Near Lodha Paradise, Majiwada, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400601. Phone +91 99306 15554
- Dhokali Branch: Shop No. 5, Anandi Niwas, Opposite Twinkle Tower, Near Highland Residency, Dhokali, Thane West. Phone +91 82916 15554
- Email: tgtdentalclinic@gmail.com
